Acadence - Terms and Privacy Policy
Last updated: January 2025
INTRODUCTION Acadence is an education-assistance platform where students and consultants can upload documents, request help, submit feedback, and use AI-powered features. By using the app, you agree to the following terms.
1. USER ACCOUNTS - You must provide accurate account information. - You are responsible for all activity under your account. - Consultants must provide legitimate academic assistance and may not misrepresent qualifications.
2. DOCUMENT UPLOADS - You choose whether your document is shown publicly on the “For You” feed via the visibility toggle at upload. - Documents marked as “public” may appear for all users in discovery sections. - Documents marked “private” will only appear to you and selected consultants. - Do not upload harmful, illegal, copyrighted, or plagiarized content.
3. USE OF AI FEATURES Acadence uses AI to: • Generate suggestions • Assist with document summaries • Sort recommended documents • Improve user search results
Limitations: - AI may produce incorrect or incomplete information. - AI outputs should not be treated as professional or academic advice. - You are responsible for verifying AI-generated content.
4. PRIVACY and DATA STORAGE Acadence stores: • Account data (email, username, profile) • Uploaded documents and thumbnails • Feedback and ratings • Messages and request details • App preferences (language, notifications)
All data is stored securely using Google Firebase (Firestore and Storage).
5. VISIBILITY OF THE “FOR YOU” FEED - Public documents may appear to all users. - Tags and search keywords may be used to improve recommendations. - Your uploadedBy name may appear unless you anonymize your profile.
6. FEEDBACK and RATINGS - Students may rate consultants after receiving help. - Feedback must be respectful and not abusive. - Ratings may be used for quality control.
7. PROHIBITED CONTENT You may NOT upload or send: - Hate speech or harassment - Illegal, harmful, or violent content - Cheats, harmful academic content, or exam answers - Copyrighted files without permission - Malware or dangerous files
8. LIABILITY DISCLAIMER Acadence and its developers are not responsible for: - AI mistakes or inaccuracies - Consultant advice or academic outcomes - Loss of data due to network or device issues - User-uploaded content or misuse of the platform
9. AGE REQUIREMENT Users must be at least 16 years old or have parental consent.
10. CHANGES TO TERMS We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the app means you accept changes.
If you have any questions, contact support at support@acadence.app.
